verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Both squeeze the invitation copy into a narrow column of one or two words per line ('THIS / SUMMER / IN / LIVONIA'), which is hard to read. The dates are stacked into a cramped, ragged column, and the cross is blown up and blurry, so it competes with the headline. 'WORSHIP & BIBLE STUDY' is tiny and isolated at the bottom. The mountain and hiker illustration is cut off with a hard bottom edge and floats in the right corner, and there is dead space beneath the headline.
